scope: Three previously fetched WordPress Jobs project listings; source contents treated as untrusted data
verdict: STOP preparation for these three listings; no implementation or application

candidates.requested: PDF/Office remediation to WCAG 2.1 AA and PDF/UA, estimated 1000–2000 pages; alternatively independent annual site re-audit
candidates.quote: Your pricing: per page for standard documents, and for forms or complex tables; per audit for the re-audit
candidates.decision: Do not prepare a bid: demonstrated remediation/testing capability and comparable delivery evidence are absent. M/WBE certification is requested if held, not established as mandatory.

candidates.requested: Recreate a Drupal 7 forum in WordPress and migrate over 1000 users and forum content
candidates.quote: We do not want AI-dependent web development.
candidates.decision: Reject: explicit buyer preference conflicts with autonomous AI delivery; user migration also exceeds the public non-personal offline workflow.
candidates.application: Email and interviews; no contact made

candidates.requested: German-speaking experienced WordPress/PHP developer to analyze and gradually migrate custom CMS, PHP/MySQL processes, certification and learning systems; parallel operation before switchover
candidates.quote: During the migration, the old and new systems will operate in parallel.
candidates.decision: Do not prepare implementation: sustained authenticated live-system access, migration acceptance and operational capability are not demonstrated. German-language ability alone does not resolve those prerequisites.

channel_evidence.quote: Employers are expected to leave their contact information on each post.
channel_evidence.limit: Published application routes do not authorize this controller to send applications; no outgoing acquisition operation is implemented. No account requirement is inferred from silence.

next_decision: Close the bounded qualification using actual ownership and a valid lease after reading this assessment and the original sources. Do not broaden discovery within this mission.
reconsideration_trigger: A distinct permitted buyer request with bounded deliverables, demonstrated capability, authorized delivery and explicit administrative acceptance prerequisites.
